definitions.meaning: An observer of the dial, an observer of times and seasons, an astrologer, diviner

source_text: dægmǽl-sceáwere. Substitute: An observer of the dial, an observer of times and seasons, an astrologer, diviner:--Dægmélsceáwere aruspex, Wrt. Voc. i. 17, 12: horoscopus, 60, 11. v. tíd-sceáwere.
